messages.text: Make a PR with the plan for review and sign-off.

I’ll commit the tracker plan, open a PR, and request review from `asalzburger-review`. The PR will ask for sign-off on the staged programme; layer choices and performance acceptance will follow the studies.

The plan is committed at `e001e53`. I’m recording the review request against that revision and preparing the PR description around the staged programme, its dependencies, and the decisions still needed before layout selection.

One dashboard test failed because it assumes the current proposals remain `DRAFT`. I’ll leave DES-005 at `DRAFT` and record the pending review/sign-off request in the review register. This keeps the tests intact and still gives the reviewer an exact revision and clear decision scope.

All 25 dashboard tests now pass, along with the 15 logging/documentation tests and required validators. The review target is `7d99d8c`. I’m publishing the PR and requesting review from `asalzburger-review`.

[PR #11](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/11) is open, and GitHub confirms the review request to `asalzburger-review`. I’m adding the PR link to the project records and checking CI on the final metadata update.

Opened [PR #11 — Plan whole-tracker design and staged performance studies](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/11) and requested review from **asalzburger-review**.

The request covers sign-off of the staged programme, responsibilities and evidence gates. Approval remains pending.

All local checks and CI passed on the final revision. Working tree is clean.
